title: A Llama-layout decoder on the GPU, over the library's device plugins
description: The device engine tests' model plugin: a LlamaForCausalLM checkpoint's tensors, its matrices in the projections slot, its KV in the kv_cache slot's pool, attention, the norms, rotary positions and SiLU product, and sampling by their slots, every step of many sequences one batch; with rounds, its greedy requests decode through Core's captured rounds, drafting from a stub draft head where the selection drafts.

unplanned_mib.description: MiB the model holds on the device outside its placement plan

temporary_mib.description: MiB of device temporaries the factory makes and drops last, left in torch's cache

rounds.description: greedy requests decode through Core's round driver once their prompt is in

width.description: drafts per round when the selection drafts

draft_miss.description: the stub draft head drafts its second choice at positions p with p % draft_miss == 2 (0: never)
